purpose: Patient-facing source catalogue and scope metadata, including a verified official 2022 NHC PDF chapter/page outline for navigation. No full guideline text or treatment recommendations are bundled.
boundary: This catalogue helps users identify sources and applicability limits. It does not determine diagnosis, treatment, drug indication, reimbursement, or availability. Clinical decisions belong to the treating professional team.

separate_packages.note: Trial registrations are separate from guidelines, evidence grading, recruitment status, and personal eligibility.

refresh_policy: Recheck source versions and links before each release and when a source publisher announces an update. This catalogue does not establish latest applicable recommendations; never promote metadata-only sources to recommendation content without chapter-level verification and clinical review.
